description: Huawei E3372 HiLink in debug mode (12d1:1566): still a router inside the stick, data through its Ethernet function and web API at 192.168.8.1, but with extra serial ports. Without this profile the option ports would make it look like a modem-mode stick to the generic huawei profile and hand it to ModemManager. Debug mode is volatile (gone after the stick reboots), so its AT ports are never relied on; AT^SYSCFGEX= on these ports can switch debug off and change the composition, so bands and mode go through the HiLink HTTP API. Some units randomise the IMEI on re-enumeration: identify by the network interface MAC. Reference only, no field report of ours. Sources: another modem manager 3.5.5 band profile 12d11566 (E3372 debug composition of the 12d1:1506 hardware) and its HiLink notes (debug reverts on reboot, bands over the HTTP API); docs/modem-zoo/modems/huawei-hilink.md; docs/HANDOFF.md 131 (AT^SYSCFGEX= can switch debug off; IMEI randomised per re-enumeration on some E3372). Its serial ports are kept from ModemManager (mm_ports control) and the stick stays a router with them: DHCP and the web API, never a ModemManager dial over its debug AT ports (profiles audit 2026-10-19).
